name: Naggai
title: Ancestor of Jesus in Luke's genealogy
summary: Naggai is a person mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus Christ in the Gospel of Luke. He was the son of Maat and the father of Hesli. Although little is known about his life, he holds an important place in the messianic lineage that connects the royal line of David to Jesus of Nazareth.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus
keyEvents.description: Naggai is listed as one of Jesus' ancestors in the genealogy recorded by the evangelist Luke. He is placed between his father Maat and his son Hesli.

keyEvents.title: Part of the messianic lineage
keyEvents.description: As part of the lineage from David to Jesus, Naggai plays a role in fulfilling God's promise that the Messiah would come from the line of David.

keyEvents.title: The link between Zerubbabel and Jesus
keyEvents.description: Naggai belongs to the generations after Zerubbabel, who led the Jews back from the Babylonian exile, and helps link this important period in Israel's history to the coming of Jesus.

keyEvents.title: God's Faithfulness Through Generations
keyEvents.description: Naggai's place in the genealogy testifies to God's faithfulness in preserving the messianic line through many generations, even during periods where Israel's history is poorly documented.
